name: agent-engineering
description: Cross-cutting skills for disciplined AI-assisted development based on the 10 Claude Code Principles (Forsythe). Includes correction codification, regression eval scaffolding, cross-cutting architectural decision capture, OWASP AI-agent security review (standalone + wired into the SDD flow), isolated git-worktree task lifecycle (create + handoff/merge), and self-contained SDD flow orchestration (no SDD plugin required).
